keyframe_scene_map.frame_01: 嵌套回纹拱门+粉橙云树+白裙女子背影，深蓝夜空，严格对称，水面倒影
keyframe_scene_map.frame_02: 同拱门场景，女子微右移，倒影更清晰，构图微调
keyframe_scene_map.frame_03: 蓝紫调，女子骑白鹿立于浅水，鹿角橙红自发光，棉花糖云树成排
keyframe_scene_map.frame_04: 同白鹿场景，鹿迈步动态，前蹄入水涟漪，镜头略推进
keyframe_scene_map.frame_05: 橙金调，金橙丝绸长裙女子伸手与白猴互动，巨伞盖云树，蓝紫沙丘前景
keyframe_scene_map.frame_06: 同金猴场景，构图与frame_05几乎一致（关键帧冗余）

rendering_pipeline.render_path: offline path-tracing 3D render (C4D/Octane/Redshift equivalent) with baked sky gradient, smooth analytic geometry
rendering_pipeline.antialiasing: TAA + 8x MSAA equivalent, sub-pixel smooth on hair and silk folds
rendering_pipeline.tone_mapping: ACES filmic, soft toe, gentle rolloff preserving highlight detail on glowing clouds

key_light.type: large soft gradient sky dome + backlit rim on cloud canopies

light_shadow.ambient_type: hemispheric gradient ambient, deep blue above / warm horizon

shadows.type: soft contact shadow, almost no hard cast shadow visible

fog.type: very light aerial perspective haze only on distant dunes

ao.type: baked SSAO, very subtle in silk folds and arch corners

material.name: cloud_canopy_soft
material.brdf: subsurface-scattering cotton-like volume, high roughness, soft self-emissive rim

material.name: silk_robe
material.brdf: glossy silk fabric with clearcoat sheen, smooth flowing folds

material.name: ceramic_arch_huiven
material.brdf: smooth matte ceramic / plaster with engraved Chinese huiwen (meander) relief

material.name: deer_skin_antler_glow
material.brdf: smooth pale deer skin with SSS on ears, self-illuminating coral antlers

material.name: water_surface
material.brdf: near-mirror dielectric with micro ripple normals, fresnel reflection

water.wave_technique: procedural gerstner micro-waves, very low amplitude, reflection dominant

particles_note: No floating dust / petal / firefly particles visible in any of the 6 keyframes. Atmosphere is conveyed purely through gradient sky, bloom on clouds, and water reflection.

motion.type: very slow dolly-in + slight vertical drift

composition.type: arch scene strict bilateral symmetry; deer & monkey scenes rule-of-thirds with subject at vertical 0.45
composition.horizon_position: lower third, waterline at y=0.72 of frame

qiyun_shengdong.evidence: Silk robes drift, cloud canopies glow from within, deer antlers emit warm light, water breathes with micro ripples — pervasive immortal qi throughout frame_01, frame_03, frame_05

gufa_yongbi.evidence: Though 3D-rendered, the contorted trunks of cotton trees and the nested meander-line arch edges (frame_01, frame_03) carry structural bone-force equivalent to calligraphic linework

yingwu_xiangxing.evidence: Deer, monkey and woman rendered with accurate but idealized anatomy; cloud canopies abstracted into cotton-candy blobs — formal exaggeration in service of mythic iconography (frame_03, frame_05)

suilei_fucai.evidence: Three-act color arc: deep indigo + coral pink (frame_01/02) -> periwinkle blue-violet (frame_03/04) -> molten orange-gold (frame_05/06); palette emotionally unified despite tonal shift

jingying_weizhi.evidence: Strict bilateral symmetry around the huiwen arch (frame_01/02), water mirror doubling the composition; subject placed at vertical third in deer/monkey scenes, layered depth from foreground dune to distant canopy (frame_03, frame_05)

chuanyi_moxie.evidence: Ancestral sources: Dunhuang apsara drapery, classical Chinese garden moon gates, shanshan cloud motifs — re-interpreted through Western 3D surrealism (René Magritte / Salvador Dalí stillness) rather than direct copying (frame_01, frame_03)

motion.camera_motion_type: slow dolly-in with vertical drift, scene cross-dissolve between three tableaux
motion.transition_type: soft cross-dissolve ~1.5s between arch / deer / monkey scenes
